name: gizza-ai/otpauth-uri
summary: Build an otpauth:// provisioning URI for an authenticator app

tool.description: Build a standard otpauth:// provisioning URI (the Key Uri Format used by Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, and other authenticator apps) from an issuer, account name, and base32 secret. Encode this URI as a QR code and scan it to set up 2FA. Supports totp (time-based, default) and hotp (counter-based), with configurable digits (6-8), period (seconds), algorithm (sha1 default / sha256 / sha512), and HOTP counter. Returns the otpauth:// URI string. Runs locally — the secret never leaves the device.

account.description: The account name / username the code is for (e.g. an email address). Must not contain a colon.

algorithm.description: HMAC hash algorithm (default sha1, the standard for authenticator apps).

counter.description: HOTP initial counter value (default 0; ignored for totp).

digits.description: Number of digits in the generated codes (6, 7, or 8; default 6).

issuer.description: The provider/organization name shown in the authenticator app (e.g. 'GitHub'). Recommended.

period.description: TOTP time step in seconds (default 30; ignored for hotp).

secret.description: The shared secret, base32-encoded (RFC 4648; spaces and case are ignored).

type.description: OTP type: totp (time-based, default — the usual 2FA codes) or hotp (counter-based).
